A Snapshot of Your Day 

As Project Lead Engineer Compressor Trains (f/m/d) you will be a team member in the global project team for compressors and thus responsible for the order-specific design execution of turbo compressor train in consideration of the budget and customer specifications. 

The position will be based in Duisburg, Germany, in a global, challenging technical environment.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Central contact person for project management and customers for all technical matters of an order
* Functional leadership of the Engineering project team
* Coordination and clarification of technical issues with internal and external partners
* Execution and participation of internal and external Hazardous Operation and Safety Integrity studies
* Forward-looking monitoring of the project from an Engineering perspective (progress milestones, budget, opportunities & risks)
* Execution of feasibility studiesas well as checks for contract conformity
* Application and justification of exceptions to the contract with the customer (Concession Requests, Deviation Requests)

What You Bring

* Completed studies with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in the field of mechanical engineering or mechanical engineering, preferably rotating machinery
* Professional experience and expertise in the field of plant engineering and construction 
* Profound work experience as Project Lead Engineer and knowledge of project execution
* Knowledge of our technical products and components, of international standards and regulations in the oil & gas business as well as of technical quality assurance as well as cost and risk awareness
* Ownership culture and initiative as well as systematic and structured way of working
* Willingness to travel on business
* Good knowledge of English

About the Team

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network,diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme

The Position

Do you have a keen sense for navigating complex legal matters and want to contribute to securing freedom to operate and defending market exclusivity for highly innovative pharmaceuticals?

Are you excited by the prospect of taking on responsibility and working in a highly dynamic environment as part of the Corporate Department of Boehringer Ingelheim being responsible for intellectual property?

In this exciting position located in Ingelheim, you will play a key role in supporting our human pharma and animal health business in bringing innovative products to the patients in need.
Join us to shape the future of Boehringer Ingelheim!

Tasks & responsibilities

- In this role, you will leverage your extensive legal expertise to mitigate launch risks from third party patents for our newly developed products as well as to enforce and defend our patents to defend our products against patent infringement.
- With a strategic mindset, you will develop complex launch risk mitigation strategies in a cross functional set up and provide tailored advice to the business how to leverage upside potential from our existing patent portfolios.
- Managing and instructing our network of external lawyers and patent attorneys in disputes including in-court infringement and nullity proceedings will be a key part of your responsibilities.
- In addition, you will support the negotiation and drafting of complex agreements to find the best possible solutions for Boehringer Ingelheim.

Requirements

- Fully qualified lawyer, preferably with honors in the second state examination. An additional qualification (LL.M. or comparable degree with a focus on IP law) is desirable
- Longterm specialization in the field of intellectual property and the pharmaceutical industry at an international level as well as extensive experience in managing large international IP portfolios
- Longterm relevant professional experience in external law firms specialized on patent litigation or in a comparable in-house position as a corporate counsel
- Experience in leading, coordinating, and managing patent litigation
- Knowledge and experience in the pharmaceutical industry
- Strong strategic understanding and the ability to quickly grasp and clearly present legally and technically complex matters
- High level of teamwork and excellent communication skills in English and German

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package. Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after – as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you’ll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Activities und responsibilities

jobs.description:
The opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Legal Counsel – Employment & Labor Law (f/m/x) to lead our Social Affairs function across Germany & CEE (Austria, Romania and Czech Republic). Based in Germany, in this strategic role, you will be the architect of our social dialogue for Germany, Austria, Romania and Czech Republic. You will not only provide expert legal advice but also lead direct relationships with Employee Representatives and Works Councils in all four countries. You are responsible for negotiating agreements, ensuring compliance, and fostering a constructive social climate to support the Group’s transformation and growth in the region.

Day-to-day responsibilities

Regional Social Dialogue (DE, AT, RO, CZ)

- Germany (Betriebsrat): Lead negotiations on complex shop agreements (Betriebsvereinbarungen) regarding IT systems, mobile work, and restructuring. Manage co-determinationrights (Mitbestimmung) effectively.
- Austria (Betriebsrat): Lead the relationship with the Austrian Works Council. Navigate the specificities of the Austrian "Social Partnership" and negotiate local shop agreements in compliance with the Arbeitsverfassungsgesetz (ArbVG).
- Romania (Reprezentanții salariaților) and Czech Republic (Odborová organizace): Lead the relationship with the Works Councils.
- Harmonization: Ensure a consistent social strategy across Germany & CEE cluster while respecting local legislative nuances.

Employment Law Advisory

Legal Business Partner: Serve as the primary legal advisor to the HR Country 

- Individual Labor Law: Manage complex individual cases across the region: drafting termination notices, negotiating mutual separation agreements (Aufhebungsverträge / Mutual Termination Agreements), and handling disciplinary measures.
- Contracts: Maintain and update standard employment contract templates for Germany, Austria, Romania and Czech Republic to ensure they remain compliant with the latest local case law.

Restructuring & Strategic Projects

- Transformation Support: Legally structure and execute organizational changes across the region (e.g.,§613a BGB transfers in Germany, AVRAG transfers in Austria).
- Compliance: Roll out Group compliance policies (GDPR, Whistleblowing, Code of Conduct) ensuring they meet the strict data privacy standards of Germany and the specific requirements of the Austrian market.

Litigation Management

- Dispute Resolution: Represent the company in labor court proceedings (Kündigungsschutzklagen) in Germany.
- External Supervision: Select and manage external legal counsel in Austria, Romania and Czech Republic for specific litigation or high-risk cases, ensuring cost control and alignment with Group strategy.

Who are we looking for

Experience & Qualifications

- 8 to 10+ years of experience in Labor Law/Social Affairs, preferably within an international matrix organization, an IT/Consulting firm, or a specialized law firm.
- Works Council Leadership: Mandatory experience leading negotiations with Works Councils.
- You must have deep expertise in the German Betriebsverfassungsgesetz.
- You must have experience or a strong capability to manage Austrian employee representation bodies.
- Regional Scope: Proven ability to manage legal topics across multiple jurisdictions (Germany, Austria, Romania and Czech Republic).

Competencies

- Negotiation Skills: Ability to lead social dialogue in four different legal environments (example: co-determination of Germany).
- Pragmatism: Solution-oriented mindset; you enable business while managing risk.
- Languages: German (Native level) and English (Fluent) are required. French is a plus.

Perks & Benefits

- Regional Responsibility: A key role covering four distinct countries with strategic importance.
- Autonomy: You will be the lead expert for the region Germany, Austria, Romania and Czech Republic, trusted to handle sensitive negotiations with the collaboration of the HR Country Manager.
- Transformation: The opportunity to accompany a high-growth group in structuring its social foundations in the German & CEE market.

The University Hospital Bonn (UKB) is one of Germany’s leading university hospitals, combining top-level performance in medicine and research with excellence in teaching. Around 3,500 students study medicine and dentistry here, and over 600 people are trained annually in healthcare professions. With approximately 9,900 employees, the UKB is the third-largest employer in the Bonn/Rhein-Sieg region. Institute has named the UKB “Germany’s Training Champion” and “Germany’s Most Attractive Employer” for the fourth consecutive year.

The following full-time **(38.5 hours/week) position is to be filled as soon as possible in the Division for Computational Radiology & Clinical AI (CCIBonn.ai)** of the University Hospital Bonn:

Software Engineer/Developer (m/f/d)

The position is limited to 2 years.

We, at the division for Computational Radiology & Clinical AI (CCIBonn.ai) at the University Hospital Bonn / University of Bonn (PI: Philipp Vollmuth – Full Professor of AI in Medical Imaging), are seeking applications for Software Engineer positions to support our software platform team. Our research group has consistently contributed to leading journals and conferences, and we are developing a range of tools to support our research projects. You can check out our work on our GitHub organizations (OpenRadX (https://github.com/openradx)  and CCIBonn (https://github.com/CCI-Bonn) ). This opportunity offers a unique chance to work at the forefront of medical AI and contribute to substantial advancement in the medical field. You will be part of a dynamic team that bridges the gap between cutting-edge AI research and clinical application, ensuring that our software tools are robust, efficient, and user-friendly.

Tasks:

- Develop, test, and maintain software applications for computational radiology and medical AI
- Program backend and frontend code for tools like ADIT (Automated DICOM Transfer Tool) (https://github.com/openradx/adit)  and RADIS (Radiology Report Archive and Discovery System) (https://github.com/openradx/radis)

- Experience with tools and frameworks such as Django, pytest, PostgreSQL, Docker, and PyTorch is advantageous
- Knowledge of medical imaging data, DICOM standards, NLP, full-text search, semantic search, RAG, fine-tuning of deep learning models, and agentic engineering is considered a plus
- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team
- German language proficiency at B2 level or higher is mandatory. Applicants must be able to communicate fluently in spoken and written German in a clinical and technical environment. Applications without demonstrated B2-level proficiency in German will not be considered
- Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal

- Exclusive access to the latest and powerful computing resources (NVIDIA DGX H200 and B200 clusters).
- Collaborate with a dynamic and multidisciplinary team bridging AI research and clinical application.
- Opportunities to attend national and international conferences (e.g. MICCAI, CVPR)
- **Responsible and diverse:** A position with plenty of room for creativity and responsibility within a supportive and collegial team
- **Fair compensation:** Pay according to the TV-L EG13 collective agreement, including annual bonus and company pension scheme
- **Family-friendly flexibility:** Flexible working time models, access to a place in our company daycare center, and programs supporting employees returning from parental leave
- **Smart commuting:** Excellent connection to the SWB public transport
- **Supported development:** Individual training opportunities through courses, e-learning programs, and coaching sessions
- **Structured onboarding:** A systematic introduction to your new role and team
- **Healthy at work:** A wide range of health and wellness programs, plus free membership at the UKB fitness studio
- **Employee benefits:** Access to discounted offers for employees (corporate benefits)

We are committed to diversity and equal opportunities. Our goal is to increase the proportion of women in areas where women are underrepresented and to particularly promote their careers. We therefore urge relevantly qualified women to apply. Applications are treated in accordance with the State Equal Opportunities Act. Applications from suitable people with proven severe disabilities and those of equal status are particularly welcome.

How to apply:

If you meet the above requirements, please send your complete application documents to contact@ccibonn.ai (https://mailto:contact@ccibonn.ai) , including:

Only applications including all required materials will be considered.

You will be part of a highly flexible development team for the MeTS Hardware Security Modules with members in Brussels, Aachen and abroad, so good communication skills are essential. The Software Architect and Project Manager for the MeTS HSM is responsible for designing the embedded application software of the Hardware Security Module (HSM). This role is as another aspect also responsible for the close management and coordination of an offshore development team from our German office, ensuring the quality, consistency and timely delivery of the system software for the Hardware Security Module (HSM). This requires hands-on technical involvement — including systematic source code reviews, creation and validation of cryptographic test vectors, and architectural guidance — combined with strong project management discipline.

- Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation of interface designs, and security measures specific to the MeTS HSMs. 
- Quality Assurance: Ensure that software solutions adhere to industry standards for security and performance. 
- Problem Solving: Identify and resolve technical challenges related to MeTS HSM integration. 
- You are a technical leader able to lead and guide off-shore and in-house teams in architecture, analysis and developments for made-to-measure customer solutions.
- You have a strong background in C, it would be apricated if you have a good knowledge in C++ and Java. The team work in an agile environment with a high demand of independent, autonomously and pro-active way to structure tasks and solve issues.
- The ideal candidate should possess proficiency in C programming and embedded systems development, along with a strong understanding of cryptography.

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are also required to effectively collaborate with team members and stakeholders. 

These qualities are essential! We’re also looking for the following skills and experience:

- Specialist in computer science with a related university degree 
- Proven experience managing offshore or distributed development teams with close technical oversight 
- Strong aptitude for analysis, a results-oriented worker capable of finding creative solutions 
- Excellent team player with the ability to build trust and maintain productivity across cultural and geographical boundaries 
- Outstanding communication skills, and a good command of spoken and written English

Who Are We Looking For 

We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. In practice this means: 

- Experience with embedded systems and C development 
- Proven ability to conduct meaningful source code reviews in C, identifying defects, security vulnerabilities and optimization opportunities
